Let the five consecutive integers be \(n,n+1,n+2,n+3,n+4\).

A pair sum of \(57\) requires the smallest possible pair sum to be at most \(57\):
\[
2n+1\le 57 \Rightarrow n\le 28.
\]
A pair sum of \(63\) requires the largest possible pair sum to be at least \(63\):
\[
2n+7\ge 63 \Rightarrow n\ge 28.
\]
Thus \(n=28\), so the integers are \(28,29,30,31,32\).

The sums are \(28+29=57\) and \(31+32=63\), leaving \(r=30\).

\[
\boxed{30}
\]
